title: You Can't Prefer Emotions You Don't Sample: Intensity Undershoot in DPO-Tuned LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.07808v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ask a language model to respond "very excitedly," and its output is typically only mildly more energetic. We quantify this effect. We condition an instruction-tuned LLM on a continuous Valence-Arousal (VA) target, where valence measures how pleasant a state is and arousal how activated it is, measure the achieved affect with a frozen regressor, and sweep the requested target from -1 to +1. The response moves far less than asked: the gain, the slope of achieved against requested affect, is only 0.26 for valence and 0.13 for arousal on Llama-3.1-8B, where a faithful controller would score 1. The model systematically undershoots requested emotional intensity, which puts a number on the qualitative observation of Fazzi et al. (2025). Our experiments trace this to the preference-learning pipeline. translated_title: 你无法偏好从未采样到的情感：DPO微调大语言模型中的情感强度不足现象
translated_abstract: 当你要求一个语言模型“非常兴奋地”回答时，其输出通常只是略微更有活力一些。我们对这一效应进行了量化。我们将一个经过指令微调的大语言模型（LLM）条件化于连续的效价-唤醒度（VA）目标——其中效价衡量一种状态的愉悦程度，唤醒度衡量其激活程度——使用冻结的回归器测量实际达到的情感效果，并将请求的目标从-1扫描至+1。实际响应远低于所要求的：增益（实际情感相对于请求情感的斜率）在Llama-3.1-8B上，效价仅为0.26，唤醒度仅为0.13，而一个忠实的控制器应得分为1。模型系统性地无法达到所请求的情感强度，这为Fazzi等人（2025）的定性观察提供了具体数字。我们的实验将这一现象追溯到偏好学习流程本身：来自EmoBank等自然语料库的训练目标以中性情感为主，且采样的候选响应本身很少达到极端情感，因此DPO（直接偏好优化）训练……
tldr: 本文首次量化了DPO微调的大语言模型在情感控制上的系统性强度不足现象——实际情感增益仅为请求值的0.13-0.26（理想值为1），并将其根源归结为偏好学习训练数据以中性情感为主、采样候选很少触及极端情感这一流程性缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies the systematic intensity undershoot in DPO-tuned LLMs—achieved affect gain is only 0.13–0.26 of the requested value (vs. ideal 1)—and traces the root cause to neutral-heavy preference training corpora and sampled candidates that rarely reach extreme affect.
